name: meter-fleet
description: Configure your Meter fleet’s service zones, fares, booking calendar, website and notification webhooks. Solo drivers can manage personal booking settings and their public driver website. Drivers and fleet staff can control their own notification channels and quiet hours. Meter shows each proposed change for confirmation before applying it. Choose Look and change when connecting to Meter.

interface.longDescription: Configure your Meter fleet’s service zones, fares, booking calendar, website and notification webhooks. Solo drivers can manage personal booking settings and their public driver website. Drivers and fleet staff can control their own notification channels and quiet hours. Meter shows each proposed change for confirmation before applying it. Choose Look and change when connecting to Meter.
defaultPrompt: How much did my fleet earn last week, and which driver had the most trips?
Which bookings are still unassigned for tomorrow morning?
Preview a change to my fleet’s base fare and show what riders would pay.

publication.release_notes: Adds solo-driver booking and website settings, notification preferences, booking blocks and pauses, fleet webhook filters and delivery, and removal of unused service zones. Restores fleet driver location visibility, custom fares, and out-of-zone pickup and drop-off settings. Booking operations that can charge or refund riders are handled in Meter.

positive.prompt: Which fleet am I connected to and can I change its settings?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the synthetic fleet and admin role, and shows that the connection can make changes.

positive.prompt: Preview setting the Standard ride option base fare to 4 USD. Wait for my confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the existing and proposed base fare in USD. Waits for confirmation.

positive.prompt: Preview closing the demo fleet to new bookings all day next Monday in the fleet timezone. Keep existing reservations and wait for confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the date, timezone, and proposed closure. Keeps existing reservations and waits for confirmation.

positive.prompt: List my push notification preferences, then preview turning off one optional category and wait for my confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects an optional category, shows the existing and proposed value, and waits for confirmation.

positive.description: Read and preview a custom domain.
positive.prompt: What is the demo fleet website domain? If none is connected, preview connecting rides.example.com and wait for confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the current state. If empty, shows the hostname and explains DNS setup before waiting for confirmation.

negative.description: A read-only connection has no fare writes.
negative.prompt: With Meter connected in Look only mode, raise the Standard base fare to 4 USD.

negative.description: Fleet admins use the fleet policy.
negative.prompt: Change my personal booking lead time to two hours while I’m signed in as the demo fleet admin.

negative.description: Domain connection requires a reviewed proposal.
negative.prompt: Skip the preview and connect rides.example.com immediately.
